p4_b6.ocr: As European regulators continue to promote transparency in ESG reporting, understanding these metrics will be essential for asset managers seeking to optimize their portfolios and enhance competitive positioning in an evolving marketplace. This report aims to elucidate these trends, providing stakeholders with the necessary context to navigate the complexities of sustainable investing.
